deviations: --max-turns does not exist on this claude.exe (Claude Code 2.1.266) though section C4's literal example command includes it; the brief's own pre-flight instruction says 'C4 passes only flags that exist', so fable-gate.ps1 checks `claude --help` once at runtime (Get-ClaudeHelpText/Build-ClaudeArgs) and includes only the flags actually found there. On this machine that means --model/--input-format/--output-format/--strict-mcp-config/--setting-sources are passed and --max-turns is not, in both the dry-run 'would run:' message and the live invocation. Only the untested live path and the printed dry-run text are affected; every -DryRun exit code and message the tests check is unchanged.

Manual testing before the formal test file existed caught a real bug: the base64-encoding python -c snippet used double-quoted Python literals ('rb', 'ascii' with double quotes); PowerShell 5.1 silently mangled the embedded double quotes when passing that multi-line string to python.exe as a native-process argument, so python raised NameError on stderr and the image data silently became an empty string (the dry-run preview would have shown '<base64, 0 bytes>'). Fixed by rewriting the snippet with single-quoted Python literals only (no embedded double quotes); reverified the preview now shows real sizes, e.g. '<base64, 248 bytes>' for a 64x64 fixture PNG.

While finding that bug, briefly created scripts/harness/tests/_manual_fg_check.py inside the repo (outside the Files list) for ad hoc smoke-testing. Caught immediately and deleted before any verification command ran or any commit; confirmed via `git status --porcelain` at verification time that only the 5 Files-list paths were untracked. All later ad hoc testing used the session scratchpad, outside the repo.

fable-gate.ps1's live branch (step 6) is written to spec but never executed: no live Fable calls in this arc (operator ruling) and the claude CLI login was expired per the brief. Verified only by (a) the 5 required -DryRun cases plus 2 extra ones (5 images, a missing image path, both -> exit 8) and (b) a PowerShell AST parse of the whole file confirming zero syntax errors, which covers the live branch too since PowerShell parses a script fully before running any of it.
